## What it is for

The **profile** holds your name, language and theme (marker-business-7q).

## The screen

:::screen{capture="settings-profile" title="Settings · profile"}
1. **Profile**: name, language and theme.
2. **Save**: applies the changes.
:::

## Step by step

:::steps
1. Open [[menu Settings]].
2. Change the **Profile**.
3. Click **Save**.
:::
